source_method: Authoritative postcode-to-geography and statistical lookup controls; official ONS primary pages only; web-verified 2026-07-24; metadata-only
fixed_operations_global: No verified external-runner output; no duplicate retry
GSS naming and lookup controls retained
UPRN/address evidence outranks postcode/area aggregation when available

sources.name: Postcode products
sources.coverage: UK ONSPD and NSPL postcode-to-geography products
sources.update_cadence: Quarterly in February, May, August and November
sources.limitations: Postcodes can straddle boundaries; ONSPD uses postcode grid-reference point-in-polygon and is not property-level geometry

sources.name: Postal geographies
sources.coverage: UK postcode structure and geographic-reference limitations
sources.role: Guardrail against treating postcode as a parcel
sources.limitations: A small-user postcode commonly contains multiple addresses and can cross boundaries

sources.name: National Statistics UPRN Products
sources.coverage: GB NSUL/ONSUD products linking UPRNs to official geographies
sources.role: Property-level geography cross-check for broadband UPRNs
sources.limitations: Statistical geography allocation is not broadband-service evidence

sources.name: Geographical products
sources.access: Public catalogue and Open Geography links
sources.role: Canonical discovery source for current lookup products
sources.limitations: Catalogue itself does not contain parcel records

sources.name: Names, codes and lookups
sources.coverage: UK definitive names, GSS codes and geography relationships
sources.limitations: Area-code mappings are aggregation metadata, not address connectivity evidence

sources.name: Lookups
sources.update_cadence: Latest versions maintained in Open Geography
sources.role: Crosswalk validation between broadband reporting geographies
sources.limitations: Best-fit/lookup relationships can differ from exact parcel geometry

sources.name: Open geography
sources.coverage: Definitive ONS geographic products, tools and services framework
sources.role: Canonical open-source route for boundaries/lookups used in validation
sources.limitations: Third-party IP conditions can apply to individual products

sources.name: Names and codes listings
sources.coverage: Current official names and GSS codes for administrative/statistical geographies
sources.role: Prevents stale/ambiguous authority-name joins in broadband evidence
sources.limitations: Codes identify areas, not properties or network availability
